description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Backtest an event-card IDEA — an arbitrary basket of crypto assets — over historical prices WITHOUT creating a card. Buy-and-hold index (base 100) over the look-back window; returns total return, Sharpe, max drawdown, and how many points. Optional trading-cost toggle: a conservative stress estimate of 2% fee + 0.5% slippage PER SIDE, so 5% for the round trip, taken once against deployed capital (ending capital x0.95); Sharpe and max drawdown are computed on the gross path and do not move with the toggle. The live event-card taker fee is 0.2% per fill. Read-only, instant, no money moves. Crypto legs only.

constituents.description: Basket legs, each {symbol, weight}. 2-20 legs; weights are renormalized. Crypto tickers only.

include_fees.description: Apply estimated trading costs: 2% fee + 0.5% slippage per side, 5% round trip, charged once at exit. Sharpe and drawdown stay on the gross path.

period_days.description: Look-back window in days. One of 7, 30, 90, 180, 365.

name: backtest_event_card_idea
title: Backtest Event Card Idea
